subject.title: fix(dreaming): drop heartbeat assistant responses from dream corpus

question: Should this fix preserve existing Dreaming corpus and diary artifacts and converge forward, or perform a one-time derived-state rebaseline on upgrade?
rationale: Current ingestion skips unchanged fully scanned transcripts and appends derived output, so the patch prevents new pollution but cannot determine the intended retention of already-derived user-visible state.

options.title: Forward-only convergence
options.body: Preserve existing derived artifacts and require proof that they stop influencing new Light and REM output within an explicitly accepted bounded window.

options.title: One-time rebaseline
options.body: Version or archive affected derived state so upgraded installations immediately rebuild without prior heartbeat noise.

recommendation.title: Forward-only convergence
recommendation.body: Preserve existing derived artifacts and require proof that they stop influencing new Light and REM output within an explicitly accepted bounded window.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR discussion already routes this exact policy choice to @steipete, who also owns relevant provenance history and recent memory-state work.
